summary: Russian forces launched a massive overnight drone and missile attack on the Kyiv region killing at least 18 people including children and striking a railway depot, while Putin ordered massive strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure and declared negotiations frozen. Ukrainian forces conducted retaliatory strikes on Russian drone facilities in occupied Donetsk and Crimea, a command post in Zaporizhzhia region, and a fuel depot in Belgorod region. Russia claimed its air defenses shot down 109 Ukrainian drones over Russian territory and the Black Sea.
key_points: Russian overnight attack on Kyiv region killed 8 in Kyiv districts and 3 in Boryspil with 12 injured including children, plus 7 Ukrzaliznytsia workers killed at depot by ballistic strike. (Source: @UkraineNow/83814)

Ukrainian strikes hit drone storage and launch sites in Donetsk and Hvardiiske (Crimea), communications node in Myrne (Crimea), command post in Polohy (Zaporizhzhia), equipment concentration in Verkhnyokamianka (Luhansk), and fuel depot in Borysivka (Belgorod). (Source: @UkraineNow/83819)
Putin ordered massive combined strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure and stated negotiations with Ukraine are frozen. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/72984)

Russia launched jet-powered Shahed-4/5 drones from Gvardeyskoye airfield (Crimea) and Orel-Yuzhny polygon (Orel region) targeting multiple Ukrainian regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/72983, @mon1tor_ua/72979)
Russian air defense claimed 109 Ukrainian drones destroyed over Russian regions and Black Sea in one day. (Source: @tass_agency/393118)
Putin stated Russian troops are increasing offensive tempo in the war zone. (Source: @tass_agency/393141)
Ukraine's wage arrears reached UAH 3.84 billion as of August 1, 2026, up 10.3% year-on-year. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32928)
Germany accused Russia of Leipzig airport explosion, closing Russian consulate in Bonn and "Russian House" in Berlin, adding new sanctions. (Source: @UkraineNow/83826)

points: Ukrainian General Staff reported strikes on August 31 and night of September 1 targeting Russian drone facilities in occupied Donetsk and Hvardiiske (Crimea), a communications node in Myrne (Crimea), a command post in Polohy (Zaporizhzhia region), military equipment concentration in Verkhnyokamianka (Luhansk region), and a fuel depot in Borysivka (Belgorod region, Russia). (Source: @UkraineNow/83819)

Ukraine's Air Force communications head Yuriy Ignat warned jet drone attacks could increase, noting Russia launched five times more jet drones in July than June, making interception more difficult due to high speed. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32921)

State Statistics Service reported wage arrears of UAH 3.84 billion as of August 1, 2026, up 10.3% year-on-year, with average debt per affected employee rising 18.1% to UAH 74,200, equivalent to 2.3 average monthly salaries. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32928)
Language Ombudsman Elena Ivanovskaya stated parents may be fined up to UAH 11,900 for using Russian in school chats. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32912)

Head of State Consumer Service Anatoly Katerenchuk advised Ukrainians to maintain 7-12 day food and water reserves due to threat of enemy shelling, but not to hoard for months. (Source: @UkraineNow/83827)
GUR chief Budanov approved moving school classes to bomb shelters, stating children forged in difficult conditions become a strong generation. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32915)
EU foreign policy chief Kallas said EU defense ministers made no specific decisions on providing Patriot missiles to Kyiv. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32923)

Putin declared Russia wants to end the war and achieve lasting peace, not freeze it, and stated no incorrect pressure is being applied on Russia regarding Ukraine settlement. (Source: @tass_agency/393152)
Putin ordered massive combined strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure and stated negotiations with Ukraine are frozen. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/72984)
Putin claimed Ukrainian strikes on Russian trading ports caused damage of about 1% of GDP, not critical, with about 100 ships damaged in 40 days and some fatalities. (Source: @tass_agency/393148)
Russian air defense reported shooting down 109 Ukrainian drones over Russian regions and Black Sea waters in one day. (Source: @tass_agency/393118)
Putin stated a large number of drones attempted to attack Moscow, St. Petersburg, and three oil refineries overnight, calling drones the main challenge. (Source: @tass_agency/393142)
Putin said Russian troops are increasing offensive tempo in the special operation zone. (Source: @tass_agency/393141)

Putin signed a decree on measures to ensure security of Russian critical infrastructure objects, allowing temporary management of infrastructure whose owners neglect security measures. (Source: @tass_agency/393145)
DeepState map update shows enemy advanced near Myrnivka (likely in Donetsk region). (Source: @DeepStateUA/23789)
Enemy tactical aviation activity reported on eastern front, with threat of air strikes for frontline areas. (Source: @kpszsu/75809)
Kharkiv region experienced strike drone (1 group) and reactive drone (3 groups) activity. (Source: @eRadarrua/109680)
Russian forces launched jet-powered Shahed-4/5 drones from Orel-Yuzhny polygon (Orel region) targeting eastern Ukrainian regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/72979)
Ukrainian strikes hit command post in Polohy (Zaporizhzhia region) and military equipment concentration in Verkhnyokamianka (Luhansk region). (Source: @UkraineNow/83819)
Chernihiv region detected reactive drones near Kulykivka heading south, and near Slavutych heading south. (Source: @kpszsu/75772, @kpszsu/75808)

Kyiv region experienced multiple air alerts with reactive drones approaching from north (Darnytsia to Poznyaky, TETs-5) and from Barishivka to Brovary, Desna to Velyka Dymerka. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/72948, @eRadarrua/109651)
Kyiv air raid alert at 20:43, all-clear at 21:44 on September 1, 2026. (Source: @eRadarrua/109652, @eRadarrua/109682)
Russian jet drones launched from Orel-Yuzhny polygon (Orel region) flew toward northern Ukrainian regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/72979)
Poltava region reported high-speed target heading toward Mashivka. (Source: @kpszsu/75790)
Odesa region's Orlivka checkpoint on Romanian border damaged by Russian attack, pedestrian and vehicle crossing temporarily suspended. (Source: @UkraineNow/83815)
Ukrainian strikes targeted drone storage and launch sites in Hvardiiske (Crimea) and communications node in Myrne (Crimea). (Source: @UkraineNow/83819)
Russian jet-powered Shahed-4/5 drones launched from Gvardeyskoye airfield in occupied Crimea. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/72983)
Ukrainian Fire Point company published video of Flamingo missile and drone launches, warning Russia of new attacks. (Source: @UkraineNow/83818)
Vinnytsia region detected reactive drones near Sharhorod, and near Chechelnik and Bershad heading northwest. (Source: @eRadarrua/109674, @kpszsu/75816)
